about: [O6b] The havoc, after the critic (brief O6b section 3; the cold play's blocker: 'ram every car on Grand Ave until each is a wreck' could not be won, and this proof checked states, not wrecks). ?start=smash.ten by the keys a player presses (tools/lib/o6b_damage.mjs ram, untilFire): E into my coupe; up the east kerb a diagonal from the lane under the el into each one's door, again and again (backing off for a run-up) until it burns; round the junction at Centre St; down the west kerb head-on into each one's tail until it burns; my car spent (smoking, on a hub, burning): E out, a walk to the next car I can take (the three spare coupes, the coupe, the lorries), E in. The check counts WRECKS: at least nine of the ten parked cars burnt out by the rams and the blasts' chain (the last may still be on its fuse), never a fail; everything that came off at rest on the road, none floating, none in a wall, no door on its edge. node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/o6b_ram.json

steps.label: the ten rammed by the keys, each until it burns, my car swapped when spent, never a fail

steps.eval: JSON.stringify(G.city.cars.map((c, i) => [i, c.kind, +c.damage.toFixed(2), c.smashD && c.smashD.state, c.spare ? 'spare' : '']))

steps.name: never a fail: out of every burning car in time (the wrecks are the rams' and the chain's, not a retry's)
at least nine of the ten parked cars wrecks by ramming (and the blasts' chain)

steps.eval: (() => { const S = G.stage.smash, st = G.stage; const P = S.out.filter((i) => i.part); const R = { n: P.length, kinds: {}, live: 0, floating: [], inWall: [], edge: [] }; for (const it of P) { R.kinds[it.kind] = (R.kinds[it.kind] || 0) + 1; if (it.state === 'live') R.live++; const b = it.body; if (!b) continue; let low = Infinity; for (const sx of [-1, 1]) for (const sy of [-1, 1]) for (const sz of [-1, 1]) { const r = new N.THREE.Vector3(sx * b.e.x, sy * b.e.y, sz * b.e.z).applyQuaternion(it.Q); const y = b.p.y + r.y - st.surfaceY(b.p.x + r.x, b.p.z + r.z); if (y < low) low = y; } if (it.state === 'rest' && low > 0.06) R.floating.push([it.kind, +low.toFixed(2)]); if (it.state === 'rest' && it.kind === 'cardoor' && Math.abs(new N.THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1).applyQuaternion(it.Q).y) < 0.9) R.edge.push([+b.p.x.toFixed(1), +b.p.z.toFixed(1)]); for (const o of st.colliders.near(b.p.x, b.p.z, 1)) { if (o.gone || o === it.lie || o.r != null || o.tag !== 'wall') continue; const dx = b.p.x - o.cx, dz = b.p.z - o.cz; const lx = dx * o.c - dz * o.s, lz = dx * o.s + dz * o.c; if (Math.abs(lx) < o.hx - 0.1 && Math.abs(lz) < o.hz - 0.1) R.inWall.push([it.kind, +b.p.x.toFixed(1), +b.p.z.toFixed(1)]); } } window.__o6bParts = R; return JSON.stringify(R); })()

steps.name: every part off at rest: none floating, none in a wall, no door on its edge
